title: DAP errors are not reported to users due to `showUser` property being `false`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible since 62120c7841182cde448b94018ec924cde4369896

### System information

Arch Linux

### Issue description

On the initial DAP implementation, the `showUser` property of a DAP error was left uninitialized. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/91454 fixed this by hardcoding the variable to `false`.

However, the current DAP errors contain user-oriented information that should be displayed in order to help with troubleshooting issues. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112879 is one instance of that, where an error message should have been displayed explaining why the `attach` request was not working in their setup.

[All current DAP errors](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b15a13eed39d902fafb14ca0637c5827c80b2bc9/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_parser.cpp#L91) need be displayed to the end user. So in practice, it should be a matter of changing the currently hardcoded value to `true`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b15a13eed39d902fafb14ca0637c5827c80b2bc9/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_types.h#L179

### Steps to reproduce

> [!NOTE]
>  This example is specific only to VSCode

- Setup a blank Godot project
- Setup [external editor support](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/editor/external_editor.html#lsp-dap-support), and generate some request that will result in an error. e.g. attempt to launch on platform `unknown` with the following configuration:
```json
{
	"name": "GDScript: Launch Project",
	"type": "godot",
	"request": "launch",
	"project": "${workspaceFolder}",
	"port": 6007,
	"debugServer": 6006,
	"platform": "unknown"
}
```
- Open the Godot editor on the project, and attempt to debug the externally.
- Observe likely no useful feedback from the external editor, like the connection simply closing or staying dangling (e.g. in VSCode, the editor disconnects after the error, not showing any other useful info to the user)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

> [!NOTE]
> This MRP has a sample debug configuration only for VSCode
 
[repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23633865/repro.zip)
